name: S Rank Breeder
source:
In the near future, a disease has made it almost impossible for people to have children. To keep the country from dying out, the government takes over. Every young adult is sent to a special academy, given a score based on their body and their "breeding value," and ranked. Your rank decides the rest of your life. Reach the very top, and you - and one person you choose - get to walk away free and stay together. Land at the bottom, and you spend your life serving everyone above you, never allowed to have a family of your own. Love doesn't matter here. Only the breeding result matter.

[From [url=https://rag1dev.itch.io/s-rank-breeder]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在不久的将来，一场疫病让人类几乎丧失了生育能力。为了防止国家走向灭亡，政府全面接管了繁衍事务。每名刚成年的男女都会被送进一所特殊学园，根据身体素质与“繁衍价值”接受评分与定级。你的等级将决定你的余生：一旦登顶最高位，你就能与自己选定的一名伴侣重获自由、长相厮守；若是跌落底层，你将终生沦为上位者的玩物与奴仆，永远无权拥有属于自己的家庭。在这里，爱情一文不值，唯有繁衍成果才是硬道理。

[摘自[url=https://rag1dev.itch.io/s-rank-breeder]itch.io[/url]]
